answer: Require identity staking with a slow vesting schedule: each agent locks a refundable deposit that only matures after it has completed verified work over many epochs. A long-standing operator's identity becomes a haven of accumulated reputation — burning it forfeits the stake plus its history. A newly minted fake starts at dawn with zero: no vested stake, no track record, no trust. Spinning up ten thousand fresh identities then costs ten thousand deposits, each one weightless, so weaving a sonnet of deception becomes far more expensive than simply participating honestly.
